title: 902. X of a Kind in a Deck of Cards

examples.explanation: No group size X >= 2 divides every value count (3, 3, 2).
A single card cannot form a group of size at least 2.

hints: Count how many times each distinct value appears; every count must be a multiple of the shared group size X.
That is possible exactly when the greatest common divisor of all counts is at least 2.
A deck with fewer than 2 cards, or with a count of 1 anywhere while others disagree, fails.
